file_to_url:
strip output_dir prefix; /index.html -> // (root index.html -> /); any other

.html -> /

.html keeping the suffix
second_source_of_truth: hand count of starter source pages (index.markdown, about.markdown, 1 post in _posts/); the build log prints no page count
discrepancy_fixed: The first candidate rule, **/index.html, would have reported 2 routes vs the hand count of 3 source pages; investigation showed the starter's about/index.html is directory-style only because its front matter sets permalink: /about/ -- Jekyll's true default page style is file-style <path>.html (contact.md -> contact.html, docs/guide.md -> docs/guide.html). The rule was corrected to **/*.html minus 404.html before final verification, after which rule and hand count agreed.
gotchas: Pages render as file-style <path>.html by default (contact.html, docs/guide.html); the starter's about/index.html looks directory-style only because its front matter sets permalink: /about/, so a **/index.html rule undercounts (2 vs 3).
Posts use the date permalink by default (jekyll/update/2026/09/24/welcome-to-jekyll.html) and are pages; excluding nested paths or non-index files would drop them.
feed.xml (generated by jekyll-feed) lists posts but is not a page and must be excluded.
404.html is emitted at _site root and must be excluded.
assets/** (minima CSS, CSS map, SVG icons) are not pages.
The build log prints no page count ('done in N seconds' only), so the second source of truth was a hand count of source pages.
Pagination trap not applicable: the default starter has no pagination plugin configured, so no duplicate paginated pages exist.
